bosses.name: Malik Veyran
bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You have entered my nervous system.
There is no outside. Only me.
death: The signal is quiet. You earned the rifle.
Nadir is yours now. Make it mean something.

bosses.name: HECATE–9
bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Every corridor belongs to my factory.
death: The forge is cooling. Take the cutter.
No more orders. No more heat. You can go.

bosses.name: CHIMERA–9
bosses.speaker: hyperion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Come closer. I can hear your blood.
death: I can finally breathe. Take the weapon.
The chamber is open. Let the others out.

bosses.name: ORACLE–7
bosses.speaker: electra
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Every route ends at this core.
I have already seen your next move.
death: I did not see this ending. The rifle is yours.
One choice was still yours to make.

bosses.name: GRAVEMIND–4
bosses.speaker: atlas
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You should have stayed above ground.
The core is mine to bury.
Stay where the heat can find you.
I can outlast the alarms. Can you?
death: The pressure is gone. Keep the core stable.
That is enough. Let the chamber rest.

bosses.name: Null Archivist
bosses.speaker: orion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Your identity is not in the archive.
I kept the names they tried to erase.
death: Keep the last record. The rail is yours.
Remember that someone was here.

bosses.name: HALCYON–3
bosses.speaker: pandora
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Reserve pressure is under my control.
The ice will keep your name.
death: The ice is breaking. Take the weapon.
Keep moving. The cold will not wait.

bosses.name: RELAY–0
bosses.speaker: hermes
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You cannot hide from a transmission.
death: The noise is gone. Choose your own route.
At last, a clear channel. You can leave.

bosses.name: TITAN–12
bosses.speaker: zeus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: This yard was built to hold you.
death: The supports are failing. Take the cannon and run.
That was the last load I could carry.

bosses.name: Director Kest
bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You reached Command. That took longer than expected.
Security, I will handle this personally.
Move left. I know your pattern.
Every door you opened was mine.
death: I thought this place would outlast us. I was wrong.
Take the rifle. Finish what I could not.

bosses.name: MNEMOSYNE–6
bosses.speaker: luna
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Intrusion recorded. Your memory is mine.
Echo keeper online. The vault is sealed.
death: Keep this memory. The Echo lance is yours.
The vault is open. Do not leave them forgotten.

bosses.name: VULCAN–2
bosses.speaker: mars
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: The rails are live. Choose your footing.
You came this far. Do not stop now.
The whole tunnel will hear this.
death: The line is clear. Take the cannon.
For once, there is no next train.

bosses.name: LEVIATHAN–8
bosses.speaker: odysseus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: The pressure is rising. Stay out of the channels.
You hear that? The hull is giving way.
Every bulkhead has a breaking point.
death: The tide is falling. Take the weapon and climb.
The hull is quiet. Get above the water.

bosses.name: PRISM–5
bosses.speaker: athena
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Light has more than one edge.
Find the gap before the colors cross.
There is nowhere here without a reflection.
death: The light is fading. The rifle is yours.
You found the one angle I could not hold.

bosses.name: MAGNUS–4
bosses.speaker: jupiter
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Keep moving. The floor is part of the weapon.
Cross the field if you can.
death: The field is down. Take the cannon.
Everything is still. I had forgotten that sound.

bosses.name: BROODMOTHER–3
bosses.speaker: vesta
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Every open socket is another pair of eyes.
One drone falls. Five more rise.
death: The last brood is yours to command.
The bays are empty. Let the small ones go.

bosses.name: MYCELIUM–9
bosses.speaker: cora
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You can hear us breathing under the tiles.
Step carefully. The growth is listening.
We were here before the walls.
death: The roots are still here. Take what you need.
You cut the voice. The growth will sleep.

bosses.name: ASTRA–7
bosses.speaker: apollo
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: The sky is much closer than you think.
death: The uplink is quiet. The sky is yours.
Take the launcher. Choose where it points.

bosses.name: SCRAPPER–6
bosses.speaker: pluto
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: Everything down here gets broken down.
Listen for the jaws. They are opening.
Plenty of room in the scrap pile.
death: You win. Take the good parts.
Leave the rest. It was all scrap anyway.

bosses.name: UMBRA–1
bosses.speaker: theia
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You saw me a moment too late.
Watch the dark seams. That is where I move.
The next floor is already gone.
Light cannot hold this room together.
death: The shadows are still. Take the weapon.
You found me. There is nothing left to hide.

bosses.name: SOL–12
bosses.speaker: arcas
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: The chamber is reaching critical heat.
The bright bands are not decoration.
Even armor has a melting point.
death: Containment is holding. Take the cannon.
The light is dimming. Keep the core alive.

bosses.name: NAUTILUS–4
bosses.speaker: janus
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: This chamber was built to hold an ocean.
The pressure wave is turning inward.
There is still water behind every wall.
death: Pressure released. Take the launcher and go.
The water is settling. Get to the surface.

bosses.name: CHRONOS–8
bosses.speaker: minerva
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: The next second is already moving.
Do not stand where you stood before.
Even a mistake can happen twice.
death: This second belongs to you. Take the weapon.
No more repeats. Make the next moment count.

bosses.name: BOREAS–11
bosses.speaker: helena
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: The cold has a direction. Watch it.
That hit broke the outer shell.
There is no safe place on a closing glacier.
death: The shell is broken. Take the cannon.
The frost is lifting. Do not look back.

bosses.name: THE SOVEREIGN
bosses.speaker: hyperion
bosses.style: Clean natural performance; deliberate phrasing, no artificial pitch or robotic modulation.
lines: You reached the last chamber. Earn your way out.
There is still room to prove yourself.
death: You earned the last weapon. Carry it out.
The command is yours. End this place.
